Name: (CP) Dacar style portraits for Seasonal RSV
Author: DacarTheGorilla
Description:
I CAN FINALLY STOP DOING RSV [s]welp, not really...

[/s]Seasonal Ridgeside Village portraits made in my style are here! For now these only work with HDP so be aware that [b][color=#cc0000]THERE WILL BE SOME ERRORS[/color]! IF YOU FIND ONE TELL ME SO I CAN ADD THEM HERE:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Aguar/Undreya not changing to the correct outfit[/b][/*]
[*][b]Some characters will not show the correct outfit IF they change it mid event[/b][/*]
[/list]
I'm aware of some of these, like Aguar/Undreya not changing portraits but due to HDP limitations this will have to continue being like this. Worry not however! A friend on the SDV Discord server (Irocendar) is still working on the framework so once it's out this mod should work perfectly! Most of the code is done, I just need to finish some animations, and I will be doing them I just wanted to finally upload a working version of the mod for those that were waiting for this. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/vZRMTgbM/RSVComp.png[/img]
